authorization.user_reply: 批准局部先验设计及新增 1 小时预算（推荐）

scientific_question: Can an explicitly declared local polygon class and legal observations support a noncircular occupancy admission certificate for the final executed object-contact step?
evidence_level: exploratory design; prior negative outcomes observed; no new task validation

prior_family.physical_shapes: unknown simple solid polygons; no vertex coordinates or complete outline supplied online
definitions: K counts the total true physical edges intersecting Q across all modeled objects, not a per-object count, returns or artificial crop edges; other objects remain unknown occupancy
s applies to complete nonincident physical edges, not arbitrarily truncated fragments
minimum edge length does not reject a short crop of a long physical edge
signed corner turns do not cancel when bounding tangent variation
one connected object may have multiple disconnected fragments in Q
uncertain continuation outside Q must not be replaced by an invented closure
bounds must be common and fixed before future outcomes; no truth-conditioned per-shape selection

observation_contract.maximum_sources: own current scan and scans from actual current one-hop neighbors

noise.interpretation: condition on the error bound for all used returns; not deterministic under Gaussian noise
noise.duplicate_packet_rule: one source packet is one observation, regardless of repeated reception

first_hit_semantics.trusted_free_prefix: open segment preceding the lower range endpoint
first_hit_semantics.miss_information: free ray segment within range only, never the interpolated angular fan

observation_contract.interface_gap: ScanSupport does not carry complete scan/miss certification fields
observation_contract.communication_cost: full raw packets require explicit byte accounting; no claim of unchanged message budget

geometry_contract.ideal_family: V(D,P): all allowed worlds consistent with declared priors and observations
geometry_contract.quantity: solid occupied regions, not boundary samples or centroid enclosures
geometry_contract.inclusion: Uhat_Q contains union over M in V(D,P) of M intersect Q
geometry_contract.permitted_relaxation: larger finite local family with a proof that every true allowed world restriction is retained
geometry_contract.topology_rule: retain every topology not excluded by a verified necessary-condition contradiction
geometry_contract.continuous_parameters: validated interval or analytic outer bounds, not a finite best-fit grid
geometry_contract.crop_rule: record physical corners, crop endpoints and possible outside connections separately
geometry_contract.unknown_objects: retain their unexcluded region as unknown occupancy unless separately bounded
geometry_contract.partial_enumeration: unprocessed domains remain in the outer set or cause MODEL_UNRESOLVED
geometry_contract.nonempty_witness_scope: a local-relaxation witness establishes local self-consistency only, not exact V nonemptiness, global extendability or true-world membership
geometry_contract.numerics: distance lower bounds must account for all geometry and arithmetic enclosure errors

execution_contract.physical_scope: one split-execution step of the frozen penalty transport semantics
execution_contract.robot_path: S_exec contains initial point, actual clipped terminal point and the explicitly declared path/tracking tube
execution_contract.engine_velocity: actual final ControlCommand velocity, not inferred displacement divided by dt
execution_contract.motion_outer_set: Uhat_Q(s;u) contains every allowed occupied position throughout the cargo hold stage
motion_bound_requirements: material-point displacement over the entire stage, in metres
all relevant rotations, contacts, numerical/physical corrections and other robot inputs
consistent with the actual command if the envelope depends on u
neither COM speed nor received point-speed clipping alone is sufficient
local K/scale/turn bounds do not supply a global diameter bound for converting COM/angular-rate limits into material-point displacement
execution_contract.window_exclusion: B(p,R_Q) subset Q and R_Q > L_exec + r_safe + B_max; prove sup over x in S_exec of norm(x-p) <= L_exec; vmax*dt is a specialization requiring this path bound; uncertain positions require inflation of the entire position set
execution_contract.cargo_stage: dist(p_plus,Uhat_Q(s;u)) >= r_safe for every s in [0,dt]; use the possible terminal-position set when position is uncertain
execution_contract.time_coverage: continuous swept outer sets or validated temporal interval bounds; substep endpoint sampling alone is insufficient
execution_contract.post_solver_check: verify the final actual command after all modifications, regardless of solver status
execution_contract.cap_relax_scale: cannot preserve the original row certificate by naming alone; independent geometric verification can still certify a modified command

status_contract.PRIOR_UNDECLARED: one or more required prior values absent
status_contract.MODEL_INCONSISTENT: model/evidence incompatibility proved; never pass via an empty universal set
status_contract.MODEL_UNRESOLVED: complete outer inclusion or numerical verification not established, or total time budget reached; unrefined regions may remain if conservatively included
status_contract.GEOMETRY_ONLY: current occupancy included but motion/execution premise missing
status_contract.COMMAND_NOT_CERTIFIED: this command lacks the required verified inequalities; not a proof of collision or global infeasibility
status_contract.CONDITIONAL_OBJECT_STEP: conditional object-clearance certificate for this step, with all unverified true-world premises attached

no_certificate_policy.empirical_fallback: requires separate implementation authorization and explicit uncertified accounting

falsifier: A declared-prior/observation/motion/execution-consistent world receives CONDITIONAL_OBJECT_STEP, but any point in the stated split execution violates r_safe; incorrect elimination or outer-set exclusion of one allowed world is already sufficient to reject soundness.
future_logic_cases_not_executed: multiple local fragments joined only outside Q
filtered cloud or dropout misread as complete misses
continuous branch neither processed nor conservatively included, empty model or total timeout
cap, relaxation, scaling and position clipping before final check
safe substep endpoints but unsafe intermediate sweep
offline truth audit finds a prior/noise/motion-event violation
